assertions.name: covariance_epic_phase5b_dirichlet_peredge
assertions.source: Kernel = Dirichlet-form sign ℰ(f,ω₃)≤0 (identity ℰ=τ₃·cov/n! verified n≤9); per-edge sign certificate ELIMINATED (bad edges grow with n; max-dim shape not most balanced at finite n). Remaining path = joint Stein CLT effective error. No fit; no c_k.

description: Phase 5b of the covariance-kernel proof epic (qou-x631): the kernel is a Dirichlet-form sign, and the per-edge (local) certificate fails. Symmetrising the Phase-5 exchangeable pair gives E_P[(Δf)(Δω₃)]=2ℰ(f,ω₃) with ℰ(f,ω₃)=τ₃⟨f,ω₃⟩_P=(3/n)cov(n)/n! (verified exactly n≤9), so cov(n)≤0 ⇔ ℰ(f,ω₃)≤0. ℰ is a sum over chain edges with non-negative weights P(λ)K(λ,λ*) of (Δf)(Δω₃), Δω₃=c_add²−c_rm². PER-EDGE SIGN CERTIFICATE ELIMINATED: bad edges (ΔfΔω₃>0, dimension and content-spread move the same way) exist and grow with n (0,4,4,12,16,32,40 for n=3..9); archetype (3,1)→(2,2) at n=4 has Δf=−1,Δω₃=−4 (the more balanced square (2,2) has LOWER dimension than the hook-like (3,1)). So 'max-dim=most balanced' is false at finite n (VKLS only asymptotic), and the kernel sign is a weighted cancellation, not a local fact. Remaining Route-1 path = joint Stein CLT with effective Berry–Esseen error. scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.

data.remaining_route: joint Stein CLT with effective Berry-Esseen error
